distribution.summary: 重庆；福建；广东；广西；贵州；湖南；湖北；江西；上海；四川；浙江；台湾；香港
distribution.narrative: Lin et al. (2024) adds Zhejiang and reports the reviewed mainland range through explicit specimen evidence. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) reports Diospyros, Cinnamomum and Styrax in Taiwan. Cinnamomum is already represented in the current synthesis; Diospyros and Styrax should be added at genus level, matching source resolution.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xylosandrus amputatus (Blandford, 1894).

nomenclature_note: Canonical identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone: Xylosandrus amputatus (Blandford, 1894), VSN_6502. 殷蕙芬等 (1984) uses Xyleborus amputatus.
